body_markdown:
**What is RNG WORKS?**


RNG WORKS Technical Workshop and Trade Expo is a program designed to educate, demonstrate and promote RNG industry best practices helping realize development of RNG as a sustainable source of clean fuel, heat, power and products.


**Who is the RNG WORKS target audience?**


RNG WORKS is designed for feedstock owners (landfill, wastewater, livestock, agriculture and food processing), RNG project developers, operators, financiers, engineers, equipment providers, manufacturers, technology and service providers, marketers, transporters, fleets, municipalities, universities, utilities and other end-users, consumers and customers who want to better understand RNG project development, operations, deployment and utilization.


[Click here to learn more](https://www.rngcoalition.com/rng-works)
